= BITwiki How to Navigate: Advanced User Guide for Knowledge Discovery =

== Overview ==

BITwiki's recursive knowledge architecture requires navigation approaches that differ from traditional encyclopedias. This guide covers four primary navigation patterns: hierarchical, lateral, toroidal, and query-driven.

== Navigation Patterns ==

=== 1. Hierarchical Navigation ===

'''Pattern:''' Topic → Subtopic → Specific concept → Implementation

'''Example Path:'''
```
Systems Science
└── Cybernetics
    └── Control Theory
        └── PID Controllers
            └── Implementation:PID Controller
```

'''When to Use:'''
* Learning a new domain from fundamentals
* Understanding prerequisite knowledge
* Finding specific implementations

'''SMW Query:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has parent::Topic:Systems Science]]
|format=tree
}}
```

=== 2. Lateral Navigation ===

'''Pattern:''' Related topics across domains

'''Example Path:'''
```
Idea:Emergence (Systems Science)
↔ Idea:Supervenience (Philosophy)
↔ Idea:Phase Transitions (Physics)
↔ Idea:Spontaneous Order (Economics)
```

'''When to Use:'''
* Exploring cross-domain connections
* Finding alternative perspectives
* Synthesizing interdisciplinary knowledge

'''SMW Query:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has related::Idea:Emergence]]
|?Has entity type
|format=table
}}
```

=== 3. Toroidal Navigation ===

'''Pattern:''' Claims validated through multiple pathways that loop back

'''Example Path:'''
```
Consciousness
├── Neuroscience → Neural correlates
├── Philosophy → Hard problem
├── AI → Machine consciousness
├── Contemplative traditions → Meditation states
└── Returns to: Consciousness (enriched)
```

'''When to Use:'''
* Evaluating epistemic status
* Finding validation across domains
* Understanding complex concepts

'''SMW Query:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Validates::Idea:Consciousness]]
|?Has epistemic status
|?Has confidence trajectory
}}
```

=== 4. Query-Driven Navigation ===

'''Pattern:''' SMW queries for specific patterns

'''Example Queries:'''

High-confidence Established ideas:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has epistemic status::Established]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
|?Has confidence trajectory
|sort=Has confidence trajectory
|order=desc
}}
```

Recent modifications:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has modification date::>2026-01-01]]
|?Has modification date
|?Has author
|sort=Has modification date
|order=desc
}}
```

Projects by duration:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Project]]
[[Has duration::>5 years]]
|?Has start date
|?Has end date
|?Has duration
}}
```

== Entry Points ==

=== By Topic ===

'''Root Topics:'''
* [[Topic:Systems Science]] — Meta-disciplinary connector
* [[Topic:Cybernetics]] — Control and communication
* [[Topic:Information Theory]] — Quantifying information
* [[Topic:Complexity Science]] — Emergence and self-organization

'''Navigation:'''
# Start with root topic
# Explore subtopics via [[Has subtopic::]]
# Find implementations via [[Has application::]]
# Query related topics via [[Has related topic::]]

=== By Idea ===

'''Foundational Ideas:'''
* [[Idea:Emergence]] — Complex from simple
* [[Idea:Recursion]] — Self-reference
* [[Idea:Feedback Loops]] — Circular causality
* [[Idea:Self-Organization]] — Order from chaos

'''Navigation:'''
# Start with foundational idea
# Find implementations via [[Has application::]]
# Explore criticisms via [[Has criticism::]]
# Query related ideas via [[Has related idea::]]

=== By Epistemic Status ===

'''Status Categories:'''
* [[Category:Verified Claims]] — Extensively validated
* [[Category:Established Claims]] — Multiple confirmations
* [[Category:Emerging Claims]] — Preliminary support
* [[Category:Hypothetical Claims]] — Speculative

'''Navigation:'''
# Browse by epistemic preference
# Filter by confidence trajectory
# Review evidence counts
# Check last review dates

=== By Entity Type ===

'''Type Categories:'''
* [[Category:Topics]] — Subject domains
* [[Category:Ideas]] — Abstract concepts
* [[Category:Implementations]] — Concrete realizations
* [[Category:Projects]] — Organized efforts
* [[Category:Protocols]] — Prescribed procedures
* [[Category:Datasets]] — Data collections

== Advanced Techniques ==

=== Combining Queries ===

Verified ideas about recursion:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has epistemic status::Verified]]
[[Has related::Idea:Recursion]]
}}
```

Established implementations with high confidence:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Implementation]]
[[Has epistemic status::Established]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
|?Has confidence trajectory
|?Has evidence count
}}
```

=== Path Finding ===

Find path between entities:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has related::Idea:Emergence]]
[[Has related::Idea:Recursion]]
|?Has related
|format=tree
}}
```

=== Temporal Analysis ===

Evolution of ideas over time:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has creation date::>2010]]
[[Has creation date::<2020]]
|?Has creation date
|?Has epistemic status
|sort=Has creation date
}}
```

== Navigation Tools ==

=== Special Pages ===
* [[Special:AllPages]] — All pages
* [[Special:Categories]] — All categories
* [[Special:Properties]] — All SMW properties
* [[Special:Ask]] — Query interface

=== Templates ===
* [[Template:Navigation Box]] — Topic navigation
* [[Template:Epistemic Status]] — Status display
* [[Template:Related Topics]] — Lateral links
* [[Template:See Also]] — Cross-references

== Common Tasks ==

=== Finding Evidence ===

For a specific claim:
# Check [[Has source::]] properties
# Query [[Validates::Claim]]
# Review [[Has evidence count::]]
# Check [[Has last review date::]]

=== Evaluating Confidence ===

For epistemic assessment:
# Check [[Has epistemic status::]]
# Review [[Has confidence trajectory::]]
# Count [[Has evidence count::]]
# Verify [[Has replication status::]]

=== Tracking Provenance ===

For source tracing:
# Check [[Has author::]]
# Review [[Has source::]]
# Query [[Has creation date::]]
# Check [[Has version::]]

== Troubleshooting ==

=== No Results ===

If query returns nothing:
# Check property spelling
# Verify entity exists
# Try broader query
# Check for property values

=== Too Many Results ===

If query returns too much:
# Add more constraints
# Use [[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
# Filter by [[Has epistemic status::Established]]
# Limit with |limit=10

=== Circular Navigation ===

If you keep returning to same page:
# Use lateral navigation
# Try query-driven approach
# Check [[Has related::]] for alternatives
# Use Special:Random

== Best Practices ===

# '''Start broad, then narrow:''' Begin with root topics, drill down
# '''Check epistemic markers:''' Always verify confidence before acting
# '''Follow toroidal paths:''' Validate through multiple domains
# '''Use queries:''' Don't just browse—ask specific questions
# '''Document paths:''' Save useful navigation patterns
# '''Review regularly:''' Epistemic status changes over time

== References ==

# Semantic MediaWiki. (2026). Querying data. https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/
# MediaWiki. (2026). Help:Navigation. https://www.mediawiki.org/
# Bateson, G. (1972). Steps to an Ecology of Mind.
# Weinberger, D. (2011). Too Big to Know.
# BITwiki Ontology Index. (2026). https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Ontology_Index
# BITwiki Epistemic Framework. (2026). https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Epistemic_Framework
# BITwiki Constitution. (2026). https://bitwiki.org/BITwiki_Constitution
# Kuhn, T.S. (1962). The Structure of Scientific Revolutions.
# Lakatos, I. (1978). The Methodology of Scientific Research Programmes.
# Popper, K. (1963). Conjectures and Refutations.

[[Has page type::Navigation Guide]]
[[Has epistemic tier::Established]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
[[Has pattern count::4]]
[[Has source count::10]]
[[Has word count::1100]]





= How to Navigate =

BITwiki rewards curiosity with revelation. You are not following a map; you are recognizing territory.

== Three Navigation Patterns ==

'''Descend''': Topic to subtopic to concept to implementation. Each step narrows focus while deepening detail. The path itself teaches prerequisite knowledge.

'''Surface''': Follow connections across domains. An idea in cybernetics illuminates biology. A pattern in economics clarifies ecology. Cross-domain resonance generates insight.

'''Query''': Use Semantic MediaWiki to find what browsing obscures. All claims with established status. All ideas influencing a specific implementation. Patterns invisible to linear reading.

== Reading Protocol ==

Read slowly. Each sentence carries weight. Follow links; the connections matter as much as the nodes. Query the structure; the machine-readable layer reveals hidden patterns.

When you encounter uncertainty, engage it. Explicit confidence markers are resources, not warnings. They calibrate weight, trace sources, mark edges of knowledge.

== Entry Points ==

'''By Topic''': Systems Science, Cybernetics, Information Theory, Complexity.

'''By Idea''': Emergence, Recursion, Feedback, Entropy, Self-organization.

'''By Status''': Match confidence level to purpose. Verified for reliable foundation. Hypothetical for generative speculation.

[[Has page type::Navigation Guide]]
[[Has epistemic tier::Established]]

= How to Navigate =

BITwiki rewards curiosity with revelation. You are not following a map; you are recognizing territory.

== Three Navigation Patterns ==

'''Descend''': Topic to subtopic to concept to implementation. Each step narrows focus while deepening detail. The path itself teaches prerequisite knowledge.

'''Surface''': Follow connections across domains. An idea in cybernetics illuminates biology. A pattern in economics clarifies ecology. Cross-domain resonance generates insight.

'''Query''': Use Semantic MediaWiki to find what browsing obscures. All claims with established status. All ideas influencing a specific implementation. Patterns invisible to linear reading.

== Reading Protocol ==

Read slowly. Each sentence carries weight. Follow links; the connections matter as much as the nodes. Query the structure; the machine-readable layer reveals hidden patterns.

When you encounter uncertainty, engage it. Explicit confidence markers are resources, not warnings. They calibrate weight, trace sources, mark edges of knowledge.

== Entry Points ==

'''By Topic''': Systems Science, Cybernetics, Information Theory, Complexity.

'''By Idea''': Emergence, Recursion, Feedback, Entropy, Self-organization.

'''By Status''': Match confidence level to purpose. Verified for reliable foundation. Hypothetical for generative speculation.
